# Meetup

> > Meetup is a platform for discovering and organizing local groups, events, and activities based on shared interests, from hiking and fitness to tech and personal development.

Meetup serves as a community hub connecting people across diverse interests including outdoor recreation, social activities, wellness, hobbies, and professional development. The platform features both in-person and online events across various categories, with a strong presence in the Bay Area and beyond.

## Key Topics

- Local Events
- Group Discovery
- Hiking & Outdoor Activities
- Social Gatherings
- Community Groups
- Online Meetups
- Event Discovery
- Sports & Recreation
- Health & Wellness
- Hobbies & Crafts
- Technology Groups
- Friendship & Socializing
- Bay Area
- San Jose
- Group Finder

## Core Discovery & Navigation

- [Meetup Homepage](https://www.meetup.com): Main entry point to find local groups, events, and activities near you
- [Find Events & Groups](https://www.meetup.com/find): Primary search and discovery tool for finding local meetups and group events

## Activity Categories

- [Outdoor Activities & Travel Groups](https://www.meetup.com/lp/outdoors-and-travel): Browse outdoor activities and travel-focused groups and events
- [Health & Wellness Groups](https://www.meetup.com/lp/health-and-wellness): Join local wellbeing and health-focused community groups
- [Friendship & Socializing Groups](https://www.meetup.com/lp/friendship-and-socializing): Connect and socialize with others who share common interests
- [Technology Groups & Events](https://www.meetup.com/lp/tech-activities-and-groups): Explore tech-focused groups and networking events
- [Hobbies & Crafts Groups](https://www.meetup.com/topics/hobbies-crafts): Find hobby and craft-focused community groups
- [Sports & Recreation Groups](https://www.meetup.com/topics/sports): Discover sports and recreational activity groups
